name: auditable-resource
description: Wire a module's resource into the generic change-proposal / change-history pipeline so every mutation is auditable, agent-proposable, and (optionally) gated behind staff approval. Use this skill when adding a new resource type that needs proposal-plus-decide semantics, a propose-CLI verb, or a tamper-evident edit history. Also use when the user says "make this auditable", "agents should propose changes to X", "needs an approval queue", "track edits to Y", "register a materializer", or "add a propose-change verb for module Z".
